name: Visily
tagline: Visily is an AI-powered wireframing and prototyping tool that can convert a screenshot or sketch into an editable UI design in seconds. It includes 1,500+ templates, component libraries, and an AI assistant that generates screens from text descriptions. Design and product teams use it to go from idea to prototype in minutes.
